verdicts.evidence: Number() already applies StrWhiteSpace trimming, the same character set String.prototype.trim removes, so Number(x.trim()) and Number(x) coincide for every string. Measured: 1331 combinations of 11 whitespace characters x 11 payloads gave 0 divergence, and a differential fuzz of 120000 random lcov documents x paths between the delivered module and the mutated copy gave 0 divergence.
